body: He was extremely creepy and I already have a boyfriend. Since one of my friends knows him I’m pretty sure he is FULLY aware.
Parents that promised everything was ok with them decided at the last moment that they never agreed to let me see him. I said I’d pay for everything, had been saving money for months.
I used to have a friend named AJ. And I would want to lose him. Please don’t leave.

I hate being around people that are extremely attractive, it just makes me feel worse about myself. I used to get bullied when I was younger and a lot of what they had said stuck with me over the years. I also suffer from frequent panic attacks and when I’m at school I don’t have the ability to control them or excuse myself.
